G1.rule: |Spearman rho| >= 0.7 of pocket-level v against log10 tokens or mean unit length flags sizeConfounded

G3.rule: headline statuses pool all grains (as the protocol counts N); per-grain breakdowns and a word-grain-only status are reported beside them. char-bigram, code and notation pockets are never compared with word pockets silently.

falsePresent.note: PRESENT = |z| >= 4 in both halves with one sign. expected false cells = defined real cells x p; binomial reference uses the larger of the two rate4^2/2 estimates.

calibration.note: comp.divSlope is scored with its amended prediction (universal+), amended before the new definition was computed (laws/tests/comp/predict-amended.json).

selection.rule: up to 8 POCKET-SPECIFIC or REVERSAL statistics by heterogeneity (IQR(v among PRESENT)/median|v|), not sizeConfounded, not failing the planted check, shared-property permutation p < 0.05; plus up to 4 UNIVERSAL by median |z|

statistics.statement: Goh-Barabasi burstiness B (Kim-Jo finite-size form) of inter-arrival times (tokens, view stream) of the K=100 commonest types with >= 8 occurrences, mean over types; 0 = Poisson
the same B for types of frequency rank 101-1000 with >= 12 occurrences (needs >= 20 such types), mean over types
Goh-Barabasi memory M: Pearson r between consecutive inter-arrival times of the 100 commonest types (>= 8 pairs, +1/k small-sample correction), mean over types
ln(observed / chance) of the adjacent-token repeat rate within a document (repeat kernel at d=1; chance = exact expectation under random placement)
log-log slope of the repeat-kernel lift L(d) = P(type seen within previous d tokens of the document)/chance, d = 1,2,4,...,128 (linear coefficient of an orthogonal quadratic fit of ln L on ln d)
curvature (quadratic coefficient) of ln L(d) on ln d: ~0 power law, < 0 exponential / saturating
ln L(128): long-range excess recurrence of a type within the previous 128 tokens of its document
ln of mean Jaccard of the content-type sets of consecutive units over the same for length-matched far partner units (content = frequency rank > 100 and count >= 2)
slope of ln(Jaccard lift over length-matched far baseline) on ln(unit lag), lags 1,2,4,8,16,32; negative = topic drift
ln of the lag-32 Jaccard lift over the length-matched far baseline
DFA-1 (Hurst-type) exponent of the word-rank series x = ln mid-rank of the token's type, window scales 16..1024 tokens, non-overlapping windows; 0.5 = no memory

neighbour diversity vs frequency at fixed sample size: OLS slope of ln D on ln count over types with >= 32 left and >= 32 right neighbour occurrences, D = (distinct left neighbour types in the first 32 + distinct right neighbour types in the first 32)/2
H(rank bin of the next token | rank bin of the current) / H(rank bin of the next), adjacent pairs inside units; lower = more predictable company
H(rank bin of the previous token | rank bin of the current) / H(rank bin of the previous), adjacent pairs inside units (differs from condR only through the edge marginals)
soft share of rigid-left types: of types with >= 10 left-neighbour occurrences, mean of 1 if the commonest left neighbour type has >= 0.8 of them, else exp(-(0.8 - m)/0.15)
soft share of rigid-right types: of types with >= 10 right-neighbour occurrences, mean of 1 if the commonest right neighbour type has >= 0.8 of them, else exp(-(0.8 - m)/0.15)
same-left repeat rate: share of consecutive occurrences of a type that have the same left neighbour type as the previous occurrence (static part kept by the null; z = discourse persistence)
same-right repeat rate: share of consecutive occurrences of a type that have the same right neighbour type as the previous occurrence (static part kept by the null; z = discourse persistence)

head-direction proxy: mean over the 20 commonest types (>= 40 interior occurrences) of (H_R - H_L)/(H_R + H_L), H = Miller-Madow entropy of the rank bin of the right / left neighbour; > 0 = right company more diverse than left

decay exponent of company: -slope of ln MI_d on ln d, d = 1..8, MI_d = plug-in mutual information (bits) between rank bins d apart inside one unit, on a fixed-size subsample of M = min(8000, pairs at d=8) pairs per distance
entropy (bits) of the rank-bin distribution of unit-initial tokens (units of >= 2 tokens)
entropy (bits) of the rank-bin distribution of unit-final tokens (units of >= 2 tokens)
mean over units of >= 2 tokens of [ln rank(final) - ln rank(initial)] / ln V (V = types in the half); > 0 = units start frequent, end rarer
share of tokens whose type recurs within 127 units (figure tokens); null: units kept whole, their order shuffled
figure births (figure tokens with no same-type token in the previous 127 units) per 1000 tokens
interpolated median, over births, of the span in units from the first mention to the last mention inside the 128-unit window (persistence half-life)
mean over aligned 128-unit blocks of log2(theta), theta the Chinese-restaurant concentration that reproduces the number of distinct figures among the block's first 100 figure tokens
dispersion (Pearson chi-square per df) of the figure share across aligned 128-unit blocks; 1 = binomial
stratified standardised difference in left-company rank bin: first occurrence of a type that recurs minus first occurrence of a hapax (same unit bucket, position class, unit-length class)
as introLeft with the right-hand company (lookahead)
as introLeft for window openings that recur inside the window versus those that do not, stratified also by the type's own count bin (frequency-free by stratification)
log2 of observed unit-initial figure tokens over their chance number (sum of 1/len); units of one token skipped
mean over types with >= 8 figure tokens of the excess squared deviation (observed minus chance, minus binomial chance variance) of the unit-initial share
rarefied (100 events) distinct follower types per event after a unit-initial figure token
mean over types with >= 12 figure mentions of (distinct neighbour types among mentions 1-4 minus among mentions 9-12) / 8
Zipf exponent alpha = -slope of ln count on ln rank, 30 log-spaced ranks in 10..300, every 10,000-token doc-order block, mean over blocks; null: random sample of the pocket's own tokens
Heaps exponent: slope of ln V(n) on ln n at n = 250,500,1000,2000,4000 inside every 5,000-token doc-order block, mean over blocks
type-token ratio of a 5,000-token doc-order block, mean over blocks (contiguous text repeats vocabulary more than a random sample: negative z)
share of a 5,000-token block's types that occur once in the block, mean over blocks
entropy (bits) of the token mass over octaves of within-block rank (rank 1, 2-3, 4-7, ...), 5,000-token blocks, mean over blocks
Zipf law of abbreviation: Spearman rho of type count against code-point length over the 500 commonest types [INERT: shuffle-invariant, z undefined, read v]
Menzerath: Pearson r of ln(unit length in tokens) with the unit's mean word length in code points, over units
standardised mean length difference (code points) between tokens recurring within the previous 20 tokens of the same document and the others
lag-1 Pearson autocorrelation of ln(unit length) between adjacent units of the same document
epsilon-squared (bias-corrected eta-squared) of ln(unit length) on document
coefficient of variation (sd/mean) of unit length in tokens [INERT: shuffle-invariant, z undefined, read v]
skewness of ln(unit length) (0 for a lognormal) [INERT: shuffle-invariant, z undefined, read v]
pooled within-unit Pearson correlation of x = ln mid-rank of the token's type with relative position i/(L-1), units >= 3 tokens; > 0 rarer words come later
pooled within-unit correlation of x with the centred quadratic (i/(L-1)-1/2)^2, units >= 3; > 0 rare words at both edges (U), < 0 rare words in the middle
among content tokens (mid-rank > 4K, K = top 5% of types) with both neighbours in the unit, P(left neighbour is head, mid-rank <= K) - P(right neighbour is head)
ln(observed / chance) of the mean distance between successive tokens of the same log2 rank bin within a unit (chance (L+1)/(m+1) per gap), units >= 3
mean over units >= 3 tokens of (x of the first token - unit mean x) / sd(x)
mean over units >= 3 tokens of (x of the last token - unit mean x) / sd(x)
pooled within-unit correlation with relative position of g = add-one in-sample bigram surprisal minus add-one unigram surprisal, tokens 1..L-1 of units >= 4
(H(last third) - H(first third)) / H(pooled) of the rank-bin distribution by relative position (fractional thirds, Miller-Madow), units >= 3
(H(middle third) - mean(H(first), H(last))) / H(pooled), same estimator; > 0 middle richest (edges specialised), < 0 U-shaped
ln(R2/R1), R_k = sum_u sum_i (x[i+k]-x[i])^2 / (2 sum_u (L-k) S_u^2); < 0 lag-2 neighbours more alike than lag-1 (alternation / binary branching)
sum (D^2/S - 1) / sum S over unordered rank-bin pairs with S = c(a,b)+c(b,a) >= 20, D = c(a,b)-c(b,a): de-biased directional asymmetry of adjacent rank-bin pairs (0 = free order)

pooled bigram collision rate of adjacent same-document units (both len >= 2): shared distinct bigrams / sum of |S_u||S_prev|, i.e. P(random distinct bigram of u = random distinct bigram of the previous unit)
the same pooled collision rate for trigrams (both units len >= 3)
the same pooled collision rate for 4-grams (both units len >= 4)
P(unit begins with the same 2 tokens as the previous unit of its document), pairs with both len >= 2
P(unit ends with the same 2 tokens as the previous unit of its document), pairs with both len >= 2
mean over offsets 0..7 of P(same token at the same offset in adjacent same-document units), pairs where both units are longer than the offset
ln of mean Dice-LCS ratio of adjacent units over that of length-matched far partners (stride sample <= 4000 pairs, first 24 tokens per unit)
relative slope per doubling of the unit lag of the bigram-echo rate at lags 1,2,4,8,16,32 (slope of rate on log2 lag over the mean rate); negative = echo fades with lag
share of units with len >= 3 whose exact token sequence occurs at least twice in the view
share of units (any length) that are exact duplicates of an earlier unit of the view
share of the tokens of units with len >= 4 covered by within-unit 4-grams occurring >= 3 times in the view
share of units with len >= 4 whose rank-bin sequence (octave of within-view mid-rank) over their first min(len,5) tokens is shared with a unit that has a different multiset of tokens

MASS (re-tests MASS-ADD / P2): pooled slope through the origin of the footprint (distinct side-tagged neighbour types incl. unit edges) of a type over a 3,000-token window on the sum of its footprints over the two halves of the window; types with >= 3 mentions in each half; below 1 = the halves re-use context slots
MASS (re-tests P3, extensive exponent 0.84): pooled OLS slope of ln footprint on ln mentions over types with >= 3 mentions in 3,000-token windows

LOCAL ATTRACTION (re-tests PG1/PG5a): mean over lags 1-5 of the mean positive PMI per slot of directed pairs a->b (types with count >= 10 in a size-equalised sample of <= 48,000 tokens, pairs seen >= 2 times at that lag)
LOCAL ATTRACTION decay (re-tests PG2/PG3): minus the slope of ln(mean positive PMI per slot) on ln(lag) over the single lags 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16
VOID (re-tests sec 13, PG9): share of tokens in 2,000-token windows whose type has <= 2 mentions in the window and that sit in no bigram recurring >= 2 times in the window
VOID frame part: among tokens whose type has <= 2 mentions in the 2,000-token window, the share in a bigram recurring >= 2 times in the window

GRAVITY (re-tests PG2): mean over 8 size-equalised chunks of the distance exponent alpha of the lift of attracted pairs of the 100 commonest types (pairs selected out of chunk; ln L = k - alpha ln lag + beta ln(m_a m_b) over lags 1-16)
GRAVITY (re-tests PG6): mean over 8 chunks of the mass exponent beta of the lift of attracted pairs (below 0 = pull per neighbour weaker for heavier pairs)
GRAVITY (re-tests PG3, no stable exponent): sample standard deviation over the 8 disjoint chunks of the half of the fitted distance exponent alpha

AFFECT (re-tests P15): Jensen-Shannon distance (square root of the divergence in bits) between the 7-bin equal-mass frequency-rank distribution of the tokens at lags 1-2 either side of rare tokens (rarest types holding 10% of tokens) and that of all tokens
AFFECT direction (re-tests PG4): (J_right - J_left)/(J_right + J_left), the JSD of the right and left neighbours of rare tokens against the base rank-bin distribution
